text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! What's going
on?! My
body feels all warm and fuzzy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm overflowing with power—like
plain old
me's a little bit more than
ordinary now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Could this be thanks to the Three
Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna run with everything I
have!
